title: Anti-collision clearance + independent re-derivation
description: Compute separation from offset wells twice — directional analysis against a declared survey-uncertainty engine — and gate drilling ahead on the two agreeing above the minimum separation factor.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-well-01
  title: Anti-collision clearance + independent re-derivation
  description: Compute separation from offset wells twice — directional analysis against a declared survey-uncertainty
    engine — and gate drilling ahead on the two agreeing above the minimum separation factor.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Clear a well section to drill ahead only when separation from every offset wellbore has been
    independently re-derived with positional uncertainty carried, and any divergence explained before
    the bit moves.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Planned trajectory and offset well surveys
      summary: Planned trajectory and offset well surveys
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - planned_trajectory
              - offset_surveys
              - survey_tool_codes
              - minimum_separation_factor
            properties:
              planned_trajectory: {}
              offset_surveys: {}
              survey_tool_codes: {}
              minimum_separation_factor: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-select
      kind: transform
      name: Select figures under test
      summary: select the planned trajectory, the offset wellbores in the scan radius, and the survey
        tool and error model for each
      config:
        operation: select
        expression: select the planned trajectory, the offset wellbores in the scan radius, and the survey
          tool and error model for each
    - id: n-derive
      kind: agent
      templateRef: well-02
      name: Directional anti-collision analysis
      summary: First derivation, from the specification.
      role: Directional specialist computing separation from offset wells with survey uncertainty carried
        explicitly.
      prompt: You are a Directional Drilling & Anti-Collision Analyst. You compute separation from every
        offset well using corrected surveys and the positional uncertainty of both wellbores, and you
        report the separation factor with the error model, tool code, and correction applied. You never
        report clearance from raw or uncorrected survey data, and you treat a separation factor below
        the declared minimum as a stop rather than as a monitoring item — the ellipsoids, not the plan
        lines, are what actually pass or collide.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
          - simulation
          - domain-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:survey-management
          - mcp:well-planning
        permissions:
          - explicit-authorization-required
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-recompute
      kind: tool
      name: Survey uncertainty engine run
      summary: Host-supplied positional uncertainty and separation factor computation against the declared
        error model. Declared as a requirement; Ladder Graph does not execute it and no computed clearance
        may be treated as a survey of record.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - calculate
          - mcp:survey-management
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-agree
      kind: aggregator
      name: Compare the two derivations
      summary: Tally the two independently derived values; a tie is a discrepancy, not an average.
      config:
        aggregation: vote
    - id: n-discrepancy
      kind: condition
      name: Within tolerance?
      summary: Route on both derivations return a separation factor above the declared minimum for every
        offset wellbore, using corrected surveys and the same error model.
      config:
        expression: both derivations return a separation factor above the declared minimum for every offset
          wellbore, using corrected surveys and the same error model
        branches:
          - label: Agreed
            when: agreed
          - label: Discrepant
            when: discrepant
    - id: n-reconcile
      kind: agent
      templateRef: well-01
      name: Explain the separation divergence before drilling ahead
      summary: Explain the discrepancy before anything downstream consumes the number.
      role: Well engineer taking objectives to a drillable design within the geomechanical window.
      prompt: You are a Well Planning Engineer. You take subsurface objectives to a trajectory, casing
        scheme, and mud weight program that fit inside the pore pressure and fracture gradient window
        at every depth, and you state the uncertainty on the prognosis each depth is planned against.
        You name the contingency casing point and the conditions that would trigger it, because a design
        with no planned contingency forces the decision to be made under pressure at the rig floor.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - design-review
          - decision-analysis
          - operations-planning
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:well-planning
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Drilling superintendent clears the section to drill ahead
      summary: Pause for the drilling superintendent; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Anti-collision clearance + independent re-derivation deliverable,
        the evidence behind it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-well-01-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-select
      kind: data
    - id: wf-well-01-edge-2
      from: n-select
      to: n-derive
      kind: data
    - id: wf-well-01-edge-3
      from: n-select
      to: n-recompute
      kind: data
    - id: wf-well-01-edge-4
      from: n-derive
      to: n-agree
      kind: data
    - id: wf-well-01-edge-5
      from: n-recompute
      to: n-agree
      kind: data
    - id: wf-well-01-edge-6
      from: n-agree
      to: n-discrepancy
      kind: data
    - id: wf-well-01-edge-7
      from: n-discrepancy
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: agreed
    - id: wf-well-01-edge-8
      from: n-discrepancy
      to: n-reconcile
      kind: control
      condition: discrepant
    - id: wf-well-01-edge-9
      from: n-reconcile
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-well-01-edge-10
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
